request: i need a little page that shows our opening hours, with buttons for weekdays, saturday and sunday and the hours for the one i pick
design_rationale: Three hours are read at a glance, so one compact card with a row of three buttons and a single panel below: the chosen day is the filled button and the others are outlines, so the current choice is never in doubt.

verify.steps: Open the page and see the weekday hours, pick Saturday and see its hours with the weekday hours gone, then pick Sunday and see Closed.

why.components/HoursPanel.jac: The whole screen: heading, the three day buttons and the one panel with the hours of the chosen day.
why.main.jac: Loads global.css and renders the hours panel.

write_reasoning.components/HoursPanel.jac: State is one has field, the chosen day, and the handler is a plain def because nothing is awaited. The chosen button uses the default variant and the others outline, and only one panel text is rendered.
write_reasoning.main.jac: This app is client-only, so there is no services/ folder and main.jac has no services import. It only loads global.css and returns the component.

plan_call_reasoning: Plan the build: one screen with no saved data, so a single component and no server.
plan_reasoning: One screen: heading, three day buttons and one panel. The chosen day is the only state, kept as a has field; there is no server module. main.jac last.
plan_summary: Build plan: a single-screen client-only tool, 2 files leaf-first, no server.
